theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.matsumoto {K : Type u_1} [CommRing K] {q qi : K} (m : ℕ) (u v : List (Fin m)) (hu : u.length = ninv (List.map adjT u).prod) (hv : v.length = ninv (List.map adjT v).prod) (huv : (List.map adjT u).prod = (List.map adjT v).prod) :
(List.map (Hecke.σ K q qi m) u).prod = (List.map (Hecke.σ K q qi m) v).prod

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.prod_σ_of_reduced {K : Type u_1} [CommRing K] {q qi : K} (m : ℕ) (u : List (Fin m)) (hu : u.length = ninv (List.map adjT u).prod) :
(List.map (Hecke.σ K q qi m) u).prod = stdElt m (List.map adjT u).prod

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.stdElt_mul_σ_of_ascent {K : Type u_1} [CommRing K] {q qi : K} (m : ℕ) (w : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1))) (i : Fin m) (h : ninv (w * adjT i) = ninv w + 1) :
stdElt m w * Hecke.σ K q qi m i = stdElt m (w * adjT i)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.cosetFam_mul_σ_of_ascent {K : Type u_1} [CommRing K] {q qi : K} (m : ℕ) (p : cosetIndex m) (i : Fin m) :
ninv (permOf m p * adjT i) = ninv (permOf m p) + 1 → ∃ (p' : cosetIndex m), cosetFam m p * Hecke.σ K q qi m i = cosetFam m p' ∧ permOf m p' = permOf m p * adjT i

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.ninv_permOf_succ (m : ℕ) (b : cosetIndex m) (j : Fin (m + 2)) :
ninv (permOf (m + 1) (b, j)) = ninv (permOf m b) + ↑j

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.descPerm_mul_adjT_of_le_add (m j : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (hj : j ≤ m + 1) (h : m + 2 ≤ ↑i + j) :
descPerm m j * adjT i = adjT ⟨↑i - 1, ⋯⟩ * descPerm m j

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.descPerm_mul_adjT_of_add_eq_succ (m j : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (h : ↑i + j = m + 1) :
descPerm m j * adjT i = descPerm m (j - 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.descPerm_mul_adjT_of_add_eq (m j : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (h : ↑i + j = m) :
descPerm m j * adjT i = descPerm m (j + 1)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.descPerm_mul_adjT_of_add_lt (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : ℕ) (h : ↑i + j + 1 ≤ m) :
descPerm m j * adjT i = adjT i * descPerm m j

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.of_injective_perm (n : ℕ) {a b : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} (h : (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))) a = (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))) b) :
a = b

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.specialise_σ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
(specialise n) (Hecke.σ ℤ 1 1 n i) = (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))) (adjT i)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.specialise_descProd (m j : ℕ) :
(specialise (m + 1)) (descProd m j) = (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ (Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 2)))) (descPerm m j)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.specialise_prod_word (n : ℕ) (u : List (Fin n)) :
(specialise n) (List.map (Hecke.σ ℤ 1 1 n) u).prod = (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))) (List.map adjT u).prod

noncomputable def QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.specialise (n : ℕ) :
Hecke ℤ 1 1 n →ₐ[ℤ] MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.adjT_commute {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (h : ↑j + 2 ≤ ↑i) :
adjT i * adjT j = adjT j * adjT i

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.adjT_braid {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (hi : ↑i + 1 < n) :
adjT i * adjT ⟨↑i + 1, hi⟩ * adjT i = adjT ⟨↑i + 1, hi⟩ * adjT i * adjT ⟨↑i + 1, hi⟩

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.swap_conj {n : ℕ} (a b c d : Fin (n + 1)) :
Equiv.swap a b * Equiv.swap c d * Equiv.swap a b = Equiv.swap ((Equiv.swap a b) c) ((Equiv.swap a b) d)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.HeckeCoset.adjT_mul_self {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
adjT i * adjT i = 1
